def map_stages(df):
    STAGE_OUTCOME = {
        'Prospecting': 'open',
        'Qualification': 'open',
        'Proposal': 'open',
        'Negotiation': 'open',
        'Closed Won': 'won',
        'Closed Lost': 'lost',
        'Closed - Won': 'won'
    }
    df["Outcome"] = [STAGE_OUTCOME.get(s) for s in df["Stage"]]
    return df
